cobalt-current.$description: Cobalt Current — Hero background, primary surface flood, outlined-link borders — the single color that defines every full-bleed section

deep-channel.$description: Deep Channel — Darker blue for gradient depth in decorative graphics, icon accents, footer bands

electric-ripple.$description: Electric Ripple — Violet wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

abyssal-ink.$description: Abyssal Ink — Darkest blue used inside SVG decoration and deep gradient stops — never as text or button

white-canvas.$description: White Canvas — Page background, body text on blue, primary pill button fill — the neutral that carries white sections and inverts on blue

cloud-border.$description: Cloud Border — Hairline dividers, card borders, separator rules across all white surfaces — the structural neutral of the system

carbon.$description: Carbon — Body text on white, icon fills in black-mode illustrations

nude-clay.$description: Nude Clay — Warm flesh-tone accent inside decorative illustration fills and strokes — the only chromatic neutral, used to humanize blue compositions

baton-turbo.$description: Display and oversized headlines only — the 151px hero weight is the signature choice, a single weight (400) stretched across 14px to 151px to create the full editorial scale

greycliff.$description: Body, UI labels, nav, buttons, badges, footer — the working typeface at three weights, with 500/700 reserved for small headings and nav emphasis
